messages:
sarah_sales: Heads-up — ACE.ai is asking for a 12‑month dedicated commit (~12 A100-equivalent GPUs) for a POC. They want autoscale + burst. Need pricing guidance, provisional credits for POC, and quick ops carveout. cc: @maria_pricing @kevin_ops @elle_legal

maria_pricing: Can you confirm SKU mix and expected sustained hours vs peak? at this scale baseline discount starts ~20%. POC provisional credit is doable but we need limits.

kevin_ops: From infra side we can reserve capacity but want a hard burst policy. Suggest burst up to 2x baseline for max 2 hours/day, then throttle to commit rate. Also need a 48–72h provisioning window.

devon_se: Customer workload: long sequence generation (~32k) + embeddings. Recommend 8-bit quantized variants for serving; expect ~30% token-cost reduction. Also suggest KV-cache tuning before full autoscale.

elle_legal: Legal flags: DPA/CCPA review required, and a POC clause that prevents POC consumption from counting toward the commit until pass criteria met. I can draft provisional clause.

sarah_sales: Proposal: provisional 25% off for first 3 months of POC capped at a dollar limit, then revert to committed rate if they convert. Deal desk — can we approve provisional credit and cap? :thinking_face:

maria_pricing: We can approve a provisional credit, recommended cap $40k for POC. After conversion we'll true-up and apply committed discount retroactively if they sign. Need explicit PO to activate commit pricing.

kevin_ops: Ops action items: tag resources with project and commit id, add burst_policy to reservation. Suggested tags: project=ace-poc, commit=ace-2109. Opsbot, create reservation?

opsbot: Capacity reservation requested by kevin_ops. Reservation created: res-ace-2109. GPUs reserved: 12 A100-equivalent. burst_policy: 2x up to 2h/day. Provisioning ETA: 48h. Ticket: infra-4421.

devon_se: Staged rollout plan: canary on 2 GPUs to validate KV-cache hit rates and latency, then scale to reserved pool. Autoscale toggled after canary passes.

elle_legal: I'll send DPA template and proposed POC carveout language today. Customer requested 90-day retention window; we should confirm with security.

sarah_sales: Great. Maria — please post the provisional ratecard snippet so I can share with ACE.ai. Kevin — confirm infra ticket and ETA. I'll loop in finance for provisional credit sign-off.

maria_pricing: Ratecard snippet (provisional):
```
commit_term: 12 months
committed_gpus: 12 (A100-equivalent)
baseline_discount: 20%
provisional_poc_discount: 25% (first 3 months)
poc_credit_cap: $40,000
burst_policy: up to 2x for 2h/day; excess billed at burst_rate (1.8x baseline)
PO_required_for_commit_activation: true
```

kevin_ops: Confirmed infra ticket infra-4421 in queue. Provisioning window 48–72h once PO approved. ops-queue channel for status: #ops-reserve.

finance_bot: Finance note: provisional credits <= $40k allowed with finance manager approval. PO required to activate reserved pricing; if no PO within 14 days provisional credit will be invoiced as usage.

sarah_sales: OK — I will: 1) send ratecard + provisional credit terms to ACE.ai, 2) request PO, 3) push DPA from elle_legal. Will update thread once PO is in. Thanks all. :raised_hands:

maria_pricing: Ping if they ask for multi-year or mixed GPU SKUs — discount matrix changes (we can go to additional 5–8% for 24mo or fixed gpu mix).

devon_se: One more tech note: if they enable long seqs at scale, memory-bound failures possible; we'll need to enable smaller batch sizes and HW-level monitoring. I'll put a quick runbook in the ticket.

kevin_ops: Acknowledged. tagging infra-4421 with runbook.

sarah_sales: Closing the loop — I'll post ACE.ai response here.
